issue.title: Enhancement: Enable generic_config_updater/test_bgpl.py for T1 topologies

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

This test has been extended to support T1 topologies. Currently only Mellanox 'm1' topologies are enabled, but the test should work for other vendors as well. Enable the test to run on all T1 topologies regardless of vendor.

### Current Behavior

Test is skipped on non-Mellanox T1 devices.

### Proposed Behavior

Test runs and passes on non-Mellanox T1 devices.
